wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/fix_filtered_eof.py: """`feof()` jumped to the backend the moment a read filter was removed.

Third helper with the same defect. `__rt_fread`, `__rt_stream_filtered_pos` and now
`__rt_stream_eof_get` each asked "is a filter chain ATTACHED?" where the question is "did this
stream go through the filtered buffer?" — and `stream_filter_remove()` answers the first no while
leaving the second yes.

php's rule, MEASURED end to end:

    fread($h, 3)            "ABC"   feof false     the filter pulled the WHOLE file
    stream_filter_remove()  true
    fread($h, 3)            "DEF"   feof false     the remainder php kept
